# sample_data/

**SYNTHETIC** invoices generated by `python scripts/make_sample_data.py` (4 PNG + 1 PDF) plus `ground_truth.csv`.
They are clean computer-rendered documents for smoke tests and demos. They are not real financial records and
results on them are **not** a benchmark. `synthetic_003_mismatch` has a deliberately wrong total;
`synthetic_004_duplicate_of_001` duplicates invoice 001 for the duplicate demo.
